name: Strongbox
flavour: Send it up. Spend it later.
art_prompt: a small sturdy wooden treasure chest with dark iron bands, a gold lock and a round gold coin emblem on the front, and a big shiny red balloon tied to the top of its lid by a thin white string (tools/gen_props.py st_gold_bank)
doc: Bank every coin you are carrying without ending the run: it is yours whether you extract or die. The balloon carries the box off once it is full.
